description.zh: 日光是日本江户幕府初代将军德川家康的灵庙所在地，华丽的东照宫以金箔、彩绘和精雕细刻的建筑装饰著称。深山林中的神社寺庙群于1999年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Nikko is the mausoleum of Tokugawa Ieyasu, founder of the Edo shogunate. The ornate Tosho-gu shrine dazzles with gold leaf, vivid lacquerwork and intricate carvings set deep in mountain cedars. UNESCO-listed in 1999.

zh: 东照宫阳明门：被誉为「日落之门」，雕刻精绝
三猿（非礼、非听、非视）雕刻世界闻名
秋季枫叶与金色建筑交相辉映
en: Tosho-gu's Yomeimon Gate: the 'Twilight Gate' adorned with 508 intricate carvings
The Three Wise Monkeys (see, hear, speak no evil) are world-famous
Autumn maples frame the gilded shrine buildings spectacularly

admission.zh: 东照宫及轮王寺套票约1,300—2,500日元

tips.zh: 从东京新宿乘特急约2小时，是东京出发的热门一日游目的地。建议避开黄金周和暑假旺季。
tips.en: About 2 hours from Tokyo Shinjuku by limited express — a classic day trip. Avoid Golden Week and summer holiday peaks.
